links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM gynecomastia patient education responses (FKGL, SMOG)
links.effect: Mean FKGL was 14.08 (DeepSeek-R1), 14.1 (OpenAI-O3), and 13.31 (Claude-4-sonnet); Claude SMOG averaged 11 (P = 0.028). No significant FKGL differences among models.
links.quote: Specifically, the averaged FKGL scores of DeepSeek-R1 was 14.08, OpenAI-O3 was 14.1, and Claude-4-sonnet was 13.31.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the readability and quality of three commercial LLMs (DeepSeek-R1, OpenAI-O3, Claude-3.5/4-Sonnet) answering patient queries about gynecomastia, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
